purpose: Focused official-executable probes for source/manual discrepancies that affect future loss-aware syntax and validation behavior.

classification_policy.accepted: return code 0, official success marker present, no E### diagnostic
classification_policy.rejected: at least one E### diagnostic or official unsuccessful marker
classification_policy.indeterminate: neither accepted nor rejected criteria are satisfied
classification_policy.observe: targeted cases collect behavior without asserting acceptance or rejection

cases.question: Does the retained official Test3 RLINEXT/RBARRIER deck still complete with the downloaded official executable?
Does the official executable accept the source-recognized six-parameter SWPOINT form when MODELOPT ALPHA is active?

replace_line_once.replacement: TITLEONE  AERMODKit probe SO-SWPOINT-01 with ALPHA

cases.question: Which official diagnostic is emitted for the same six-parameter SWPOINT form when MODELOPT ALPHA is absent?

replace_line_once.replacement: TITLEONE  AERMODKit probe SO-SWPOINT-01 without ALPHA

cases.question: Does the official executable accept two OZONEFIL records when they target two distinct O3SECTOR sectors?

replace_line_once.replacement:
O3SECTOR 0.0 180.0
   OZONEVAL SECT1 40.0 PPB
   OZONEVAL SECT2 40.0 PPB

OZONEFIL SECT1 ozone_a.dat PPB (i2,3i3,f9.3)
   OZONEFIL SECT2 ozone_b.dat PPB (i2,3i3,f9.3)
